dict.string: Pako reads the calendars you choose to keep your agenda in view, and adds, moves or removes an event only after your yes. It all stays on this Mac.
Pako reads the calendars you choose to keep your agenda in view, and adds, moves or removes an event only after your yes. It all stays on this Mac.
Pako keeps your follow-ups in its own Reminders lists, so they reach your iPhone, and closes one when you complete it there. It never touches your other lists.

Pako imports your contacts' names, emails and phones only when you confirm it. It all stays on this Mac.
Pako asks Mail and Outlook which accounts you have (only their addresses, never your mail) to help you connect one.
Pako looks for Zoom's recordings in Documents/Zoom (only the folder names) to offer you their transcripts.
